name: Alien Barrel
description: This factory-fixed stainless steel semi-bull barrel is integrated directly into the Alien frame. Measuring 4.8 inches in length, the barrel remains stationary during the firing cycle, reducing reciprocating mass and increasing accuracy. Combined with a bore axis just 1.7 mm above the grip and Laugo’s gas-delayed blowback system, this configuration minimizes muzzle rise and enables fast, controlled follow-up shots. It’s the core of the Alien’s signature flat recoil and precision performance.

name: Alien Threaded Barrel

Its exceptionally low bore axis (just 1.7 mm above the grip), combined with Laugo’s gas-delayed blowback system, virtually eliminates muzzle rise and enhances follow-up shot control. The result is the Alien’s signature flat recoil impulse and precision handling.
